title: /llms.txt describes the theme library as it is now

source.ref: Help center audit and rework 2026-11-18 (project thread: Rework every help doc and help search)

detail:
/llms.txt, the page AI crawlers read, described Space websites as having "Two themes, Default and Bold". Default was retired from the pickers on 2026-11-04 and the library has grown, so the sentence told answer engines something false. A test in app/llms.txt/route.test.ts pinned the stale sentence; the owner approved rewriting that pin on 2026-11-18 (decision card in the thread).

DONE 2026-11-18: the line is built from SITE_THEMES, the list the pickers offer (lib/theme/site-style.ts), so it names the real count and the theme that leads, and cannot go stale again.

verify.note: Passes while the consequence in the title holds.
